label: TP
reason: User input via getParameterNames flows directly to bar via Thing1/doSomething, then is used unsanitized in an XPath expression against XML documents. Although ESAPI encoder is applied in error handling paths, it is not used on the primary execution path where the XPath evaluates. The disallow-doctype-decl setting mitigates XXE but does not prevent XPath injection via attribute selectors.

evidence.note: param from request flows to bar and used in XPath expression without effective sanitization on main path
